mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS username, r.product_id AS productId, r.order_item_id AS orderItemId, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
